crossRefs.note: and for the sacrifice of peace offerings, two head of cattle, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs a year…

people.name: Ahiezer
people.line: Leader from the tribe of Dan during the Exodus

people.name: Ammishaddai
people.line: Father of Ahiezer, leader of Dan

translations.web: and for the sacrifice of peace offerings, two head of cattle, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs a year old. This was the offering of Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.
translations.bsb: and a peace offering of two oxen, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs a year old. This was the offering of Ahiezer son of Ammishaddai.
translations.kjv: And for a sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five he goats, five lambs of the first year: this was the offering of Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.
translations.asv: and for the sacrifice of peace-offerings, two oxen, five rams, five he-goats, five he-lambs a year old: this was the oblation of Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.
